title: Nikko · Irohazaka and Lake Chuzenji
slogan: A 48 km loop out of Irohazaka ascent
story: Hairpins, cedar air and a famous ascent done respectfully. This road trip is shaped as a ride, not as a shortcut: leave the start cleanly, use the first checkpoint for fuel and weather discipline, then let the middle 20 km be the part you remember. The best part sits around Irohazaka ascent, Lake Chuzenji, Kegon Falls, while the fuel checkpoint and Nikko food keep the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel hunt. Ride it early if the area is popular, keep the photo stops legal, and shorten the route if weather, daylight or energy stops agreeing with the plan.

scenicChapters.title: Irohazaka · Nikkō
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 3 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Irohazaka · Nikkō
scenicChapters.narrative: For 22 km this is Irohazaka · Nikkō, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
